title: 雅思·经济与公共投入 · 64 句
description: 价格、通胀、税收、公共投资、创新、收入财富、消费与政策评价中的论证练习。

items.zh: 稀缺会推高价格，但价格也受到市场权力影响。
items.en: Scarcity raises prices, but market power also shapes them.
answers: Scarcity raises prices, but market power also shapes them.

items.zh: 当替代服务稀少时，消费者即使不满也可能被迫继续购买。
items.en: Where alternative services are scarce, dissatisfied consumers may have little choice but to keep buying.
answers: Where alternative services are scarce, dissatisfied consumers may have little choice but to keep buying.
items.notes: have little choice but to：几乎别无选择，只能。

items.zh: 低价竞争可能挤压企业改善工作条件的空间。
items.en: Price competition can squeeze firms' capacity to improve working conditions.
answers: Price competition can squeeze firms' capacity to improve working conditions.

items.zh: 明确的比较信息有助于竞争，而复杂收费可能削弱它。
items.en: Clear comparisons support competition, whereas complex charges can weaken it.
answers: Clear comparisons support competition, whereas complex charges can weaken it.

items.zh: 垄断企业可能缺乏改善售后服务的动力，因为顾客很难转向别家。
items.en: A monopoly may have little incentive to improve after-sales service when customers cannot easily switch providers.
answers: A monopoly may have little incentive to improve after-sales service when customers cannot easily switch providers.
A monopoly may have little incentive to improve after-sales service when customers can't easily switch providers.
items.notes: incentive to：做某事的动力；when 引出市场条件。

items.zh: 企业规模扩大可能降低成本，同时减少消费者的选择。
items.en: Larger firms may cut costs while reducing consumer choice.
answers: Larger firms may cut costs while reducing consumer choice.
items.notes: while 在此表示两种效果同时存在。

items.zh: 市场进入门槛过高会阻碍新企业。
items.en: High entry barriers can obstruct new businesses.
answers: High entry barriers can obstruct new businesses.

items.zh: 价格上限若缺乏配套，可能改变供应意愿。
items.en: Price ceilings without supporting measures may alter suppliers' incentives.
answers: Price ceilings without supporting measures may alter suppliers' incentives.

items.zh: 物价普遍上涨会压缩固定收入者的购买力。
items.en: General price increases erode the purchasing power of fixed incomes.
answers: General price increases erode the purchasing power of fixed incomes.

items.zh: 由于支出结构不同，通胀对各个家庭的影响也不同。
items.en: Inflation affects households differently because their spending patterns differ.
answers: Inflation affects households differently because their spending patterns differ.
items.notes: because 说明不同影响的原因。

items.zh: 食品涨价对低收入家庭的影响可能更大。
items.en: Higher food prices may weigh more heavily on poorer households.
answers: Higher food prices may weigh more heavily on poorer households.

items.zh: 工资上涨若落后于物价，实际收入仍可能下降。
items.en: Real income can fall when wage growth trails price increases.
answers: Real income can fall when wage growth trails price increases.

items.zh: 短期价格波动不一定意味着长期通胀趋势改变。
items.en: Short-lived price movements need not signal a lasting inflation shift.
answers: Short-lived price movements need not signal a lasting inflation shift.
Short-lived price movements needn't signal a lasting inflation shift.

items.zh: 运输成本可以通过供应链传导到零售价格。
items.en: Transport costs can feed through supply chains into retail prices.
answers: Transport costs can feed through supply chains into retail prices.

items.zh: 稳定预期是政策沟通的重要目标。
items.en: Stable expectations are an important aim of policy communication.
answers: Stable expectations are an important aim of policy communication.

items.zh: 补贴可能减轻眼前压力，却也需要资金来源。
items.en: Subsidies can ease immediate pressure but require funding.
answers: Subsidies can ease immediate pressure but require funding.

items.zh: 征税的实际负担未必由法律上缴税的一方承担。
items.en: The legal taxpayer does not necessarily bear the economic burden.
answers: The legal taxpayer does not necessarily bear the economic burden.
The legal taxpayer doesn't necessarily bear the economic burden.

items.zh: 复杂的税制可能让小企业承担与其规模不成比例的合规成本。
items.en: Complex taxes may impose disproportionate compliance costs on small firms.
answers: Complex taxes may impose disproportionate compliance costs on small firms.
items.notes: disproportionate：不成比例的；compliance costs：合规成本。

items.zh: 税收优惠需要明确目标，而不是无限延续。
items.en: Tax concessions need defined purposes rather than indefinite continuation.
answers: Tax concessions need defined purposes rather than indefinite continuation.

items.zh: 降低税率并不保证投资随之增加。
items.en: Lower tax rates do not guarantee additional investment.
answers: Lower tax rates do not guarantee additional investment.
Lower tax rates don't guarantee additional investment.

items.zh: 税基过窄会使收入更容易受到行业波动影响。
items.en: A narrow tax base makes revenue vulnerable to sectoral fluctuations.
answers: A narrow tax base makes revenue vulnerable to sectoral fluctuations.

items.zh: 可预测的规则有助于企业长期安排。
items.en: Predictable tax rules help businesses plan over longer horizons.
answers: Predictable tax rules help businesses plan over longer horizons.

items.zh: 消费税可能对不同收入群体产生不同压力。
items.en: Consumption taxes can place unequal pressure on different income groups.
answers: Consumption taxes can place unequal pressure on different income groups.

items.zh: 评价税制时也应考虑征收是否容易执行。
items.en: A tax system should also be assessed for administrative feasibility.
answers: A tax system should also be assessed for administrative feasibility.

items.zh: 基础设施的收益可能在建成多年后才出现。
items.en: Infrastructure benefits may emerge years after construction ends.
answers: Infrastructure benefits may emerge years after construction ends.

items.zh: 建设资金与日常维护资金应一并规划。
items.en: Construction and maintenance funding should be planned together.
answers: Construction and maintenance funding should be planned together.

items.zh: 低成本项目不一定具有更高社会回报。
items.en: Cheap projects do not necessarily offer greater social returns.
answers: Cheap projects do not necessarily offer greater social returns.
Cheap projects don't necessarily offer greater social returns.

items.zh: 增加支出只有转化为有效的服务才有价值。
items.en: Higher spending matters only when it translates into effective services.
answers: Higher spending matters only when it translates into effective services.
items.notes: only when 限定支出产生价值的必要条件。

items.zh: 项目评估需要考虑被放弃的其他选择。
items.en: Project appraisal must consider the alternatives forgone.
answers: Project appraisal must consider the alternatives forgone.

items.zh: 跨地区项目可能需要共同承担费用。
items.en: Projects spanning regions may require shared financial responsibility.
answers: Projects spanning regions may require shared financial responsibility.

items.zh: 短期选举周期可能偏向容易展示的建设。
items.en: Short electoral cycles may favour highly visible construction.
answers: Short electoral cycles may favour highly visible construction.

items.zh: 借款可以分担跨代成本，但不能消除成本。
items.en: Borrowing spreads costs across generations rather than removing them.
answers: Borrowing spreads costs across generations rather than removing them.

items.zh: 初创企业需要试验空间，投资者也必须接受某些尝试会失败。
items.en: Start-ups need room to experiment, and investors must accept that some attempts will fail.
answers: Start-ups need room to experiment, and investors must accept that some attempts will fail.
items.notes: accept that 引导必须接受的风险；room to experiment：试验空间。

items.zh: 融资困难可能阻碍有价值的项目进入市场。
items.en: Financing constraints can keep worthwhile projects out of the market.
answers: Financing constraints can keep worthwhile projects out of the market.

items.zh: 专利保护的期限涉及激励与知识传播的权衡。
items.en: Patent duration balances incentives against the diffusion of knowledge.
answers: Patent duration balances incentives against the diffusion of knowledge.

items.zh: 企业补贴应接受定期成效审查，而不应自动变成永久保护。
items.en: Business subsidies should undergo regular outcome reviews rather than automatically become permanent protection.
answers: Business subsidies should undergo regular outcome reviews rather than automatically become permanent protection.
items.notes: undergo a review：接受审查；rather than 比较两种政策走向。

items.zh: 倒闭不总意味着企业没有创造过价值。
items.en: Failure does not erase the value a firm previously created.
answers: Failure does not erase the value a firm previously created.
Failure doesn't erase the value a firm previously created.

items.zh: 研发投入的回报通常存在不确定性。
items.en: Returns on research investment are often uncertain.
answers: Returns on research investment are often uncertain.

items.zh: 收购小企业可能加快其产品推广，同时削弱市场竞争。
items.en: Acquiring small firms can accelerate the rollout of their products while weakening market competition.
answers: Acquiring small firms can accelerate the rollout of their products while weakening market competition.

items.zh: 生产率改善需要技术与组织方式共同适应。
items.en: Productivity gains require technology and organisation to adapt together.
answers: Productivity gains require technology and organisation to adapt together.

items.zh: 收入反映一段时间的流入，财富反映资产积累。
items.en: Income measures a flow; wealth reflects accumulated assets.
answers: Income measures a flow; wealth reflects accumulated assets.

items.zh: 资产价格上涨可能扩大已拥有资产者的优势。
items.en: Rising asset prices can widen owners' advantages.
answers: Rising asset prices can widen owners' advantages.

items.zh: 较高平均收入可能与严重不平等同时存在。
items.en: High average income can coexist with substantial inequality.
answers: High average income can coexist with substantial inequality.

items.zh: 机会平等并不自动带来结果相同。
items.en: Equal opportunity does not automatically produce equal outcomes.
answers: Equal opportunity does not automatically produce equal outcomes.
Equal opportunity doesn't automatically produce equal outcomes.

items.zh: 收入波动本身也会增加生活安排的困难。
items.en: Income volatility itself complicates household planning.
answers: Income volatility itself complicates household planning.

items.zh: 贫困衡量应考虑当地生活成本。
items.en: Poverty measures need to reflect local living costs.
answers: Poverty measures need to reflect local living costs.

items.zh: 财富传承可能影响下一代承担风险的能力。
items.en: Inherited wealth can affect the next generation's capacity to take risks.
answers: Inherited wealth can affect the next generation's capacity to take risks.

items.zh: 分配政策需要关注收入之外的服务获取。
items.en: Distribution policy should consider service access as well as earnings.
answers: Distribution policy should consider service access as well as earnings.

items.zh: 消费增加可能刺激生产，也可能增加进口。
items.en: Rising consumption can stimulate production or increase imports.
answers: Rising consumption can stimulate production or increase imports.

items.zh: 经济增长不能单独说明生活质量。
items.en: Economic growth alone cannot describe quality of life.
answers: Economic growth alone cannot describe quality of life.
Economic growth alone can't describe quality of life.

items.zh: 修理与共享会改变需求，而非完全取消经济活动。
items.en: Repair and sharing reshape demand without eliminating economic activity.
answers: Repair and sharing reshape demand without eliminating economic activity.

items.zh: 过度依赖单一行业会增加经济脆弱性。
items.en: Dependence on one industry increases economic vulnerability.
answers: Dependence on one industry increases economic vulnerability.

items.zh: 家庭负债扩张可能暂时支撑消费。
items.en: Rising household debt may support consumption temporarily.
answers: Rising household debt may support consumption temporarily.

items.zh: 企业信心会影响是否扩大产能。
items.en: Business confidence influences decisions to expand capacity.
answers: Business confidence influences decisions to expand capacity.

items.zh: 出口收入上升不一定惠及所有地区。
items.en: Higher export earnings need not benefit every region.
answers: Higher export earnings need not benefit every region.
Higher export earnings needn't benefit every region.

items.zh: 长期繁荣需要考虑资源与环境约束。
items.en: Lasting prosperity must account for resource and environmental limits.
answers: Lasting prosperity must account for resource and environmental limits.

items.zh: 政策效果应与合理的对照情境比较。
items.en: Policy effects need comparison with a credible alternative scenario.
answers: Policy effects need comparison with a credible alternative scenario.

items.zh: 补助申请者不一定代表全部潜在受益者。
items.en: Grant applicants may not represent all potential beneficiaries.
answers: Grant applicants may not represent all potential beneficiaries.

items.zh: 平均效果可能掩盖少数群体的损失。
items.en: Average effects can conceal losses for particular groups.
answers: Average effects can conceal losses for particular groups.

items.zh: 政策宣布和实际执行之间可能存在间隔。
items.en: Policy announcements may precede implementation by a substantial interval.
answers: Policy announcements may precede implementation by a substantial interval.

items.zh: 政策评估若只统计成功领取补助的人，就可能遗漏被繁琐手续挡在门外的申请者。
items.en: Evaluations limited to successful grant recipients may overlook applicants deterred by complex procedures.
answers: Evaluations limited to successful grant recipients may overlook applicants deterred by complex procedures.
items.notes: limited to 与 deterred by 两个过去分词短语限定不同群体。

items.zh: 衡量就业不能只统计岗位数量。
items.en: Employment assessment requires more than a job count.
answers: Employment assessment requires more than a job count.

items.zh: 企业利润和社会收益不能完全等同。
items.en: Business profit and social benefit are not interchangeable.
answers: Business profit and social benefit are not interchangeable.
Business profit and social benefit aren't interchangeable.

items.zh: 经济政策的取舍应向公众解释清楚。
items.en: Economic policy trade-offs should be explained openly.
answers: Economic policy trade-offs should be explained openly.
